title: Use Seedance 2.0 to turn a single product into beauty-style UGC by prompting…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 to turn a single product into beauty-style UGC by prompting specific shot types: product close-up, skin texture shot, creator holding the bottle, bedroom testimonial vibe, natural camera movement, soft organic lighting  
Workflow: generate the creator first, then animate the product demo in Seedance 2.0, then polish the clip in CapCut
